def accepted(cap: int, xs: list[int]) -> int uses nondet:
    """Make a channel of capacity cap, try to send each element of xs without blocking, and return how many sends were accepted before the channel was full."""
    pre cap >= 0
    post out >= 0 and out <= xs.len()
    post out <= cap
    ch: Channel[int] = Channel(cap)
    n = 0
    for x in xs:
        if not ch.try_send(x):
            break
        n += 1
    return n
